context: Senator's Office. Emma at corner desk.

nodes.text: G-good morning, Senator John. I'm Emma, the new intern. It's really an honor to work with you.

moodVariations.Stressed: G-good morning, Senator. I'm Emma, the intern.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Good morning! It's such an honor to be here!
moodVariations.Neutral: Good morning, Senator. I'm Emma, the new intern.

publicOptions.text: Morning, Emma. Welcome to the team.
Hello, Emma. How's the research coming?
Please, call me John. We're all friends here.

privateThoughts.text: She's young, idealistic. I could mentor her—or take advantage. Which kind of person am I?

nodes.text: I've been researching voting patterns on women's issues for Maria. There's... there's a lot of data. I hope it's useful.

moodVariations.Stressed: I've been researching for Maria. There's a lot of data.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I've been researching! There's so much data, I hope it helps!
moodVariations.Neutral: I've been researching voting patterns on women's issues.

publicOptions.text: That's exactly what we need. Good work.
Show me what you found. Let's discuss.
Maria will review it. Just get it to her.

nodes.text: Y-yes, Senator. I'll get back to work.

delayed.effect: Emma too scared to approach during crisis, missing potential help

nodes.text: Oh! Um, I don't think that would be appropriate, Senator. You're... you're my boss's boss.

moodVariations.Relaxed: Oh! I don't know about that!
moodVariations.Neutral: I don't think that would be appropriate.

publicOptions.text: Of course. You're right. Senator John, then.

delayed.effect: Emma's ending reflects discomfort with power dynamic

nodes.text: Really? I mean—yes, of course! So I found that your voting record on education actually helps women more than the Family Act would have, statistically speaking.

moodVariations.Stressed: I found your education voting helps women more than the Family Act.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I found something great! Your education votes help women more!
moodVariations.Neutral: I found that your education voting helps women more.

publicOptions.text: That's insightful, Emma. Use that in the briefing.
Good. I'll mention that in the debate.

delayed.effect: Emma more confident, provides better research later

nodes.text: Thank you, Senator. I'll, um, let you get to your day.

publicOptions.text: Keep up the good work, Emma.

endingStates.emma_intimidated: Emma intimidated, less likely to contribute
endingStates.emma_dismissed: Emma feels her work is unimportant
